title: From $6,000 to $780,000: MLB's Lowest Pay
description:
MLB's lowest pay was just 6,000 dollars. What is it now?

Sources:
- MLB.com: MLB, MLBPA agree to new CBA (2022): https://www.mlb.com/news/mlb-mlbpa-agree-to-cba
- Wikipedia: Major League Baseball Players Association: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Major_League_Baseball_Players_Association

The 1968 agreement raised the minimum from $6,000 to $10,000 (Wikipedia). The 2022 five-year agreement set the minimum at $700,000 (2022), $720,000, $740,000, $760,000 and $780,000 (2026), plus a $50 million pre-arbitration bonus pool for the top 100 players by awards and stats (MLB.com). Not financial advice.

scenes.narration: MLB's lowest pay was just 6,000 dollars. What is it now?
Then in 1968, players signed their first union deal.
In 2026, it's 780,000 dollars. Still the minimum.
But young stars can earn more. A 50 million dollar bonus pool.
Only the top young players split it, by awards and stats.
